name: vnd-ai-sdlc
description: VNDIRECT AI-SDLC harness, framework-agnostic layer. Upstream: Stage A discovery (idea-card, problem-canvas, market-scan, discovery-report, ipam-way for the A5 team-alignment canvas and OMVP charter), Stage B definition (context-doc, brd, prd with the two-way trace check that catches scope creep), Stage C design (sa-view, srs, ui-spec, test-strategy, threat model via security-review), and /gate recording all five human gates G1-G5 with their per-gate evidence rules. Agents: pm-analyst (FS18), architect (FS20), px-designer (FS19), security (FS14), reviewer. Delivery: plan-feature, spec, adr, review, security-review, pr, status, agent-metrics, update-memory, abort, notify-merge. A governed skill lifecycle (skill-new, skill-submit, skill-approve, skill-sync). Twenty-three versioned templates covering every phase-boundary artefact from Company Context and Issue Report through IPAM Way, OMVP, BRD, PRD, SRS, Threat Model and the traceability manifest (v3). A document-conventions standard every template inherits, derived from the organisation's own shipped documents: identity block, version-history changelog, permanent declared ids, explicit absence, inline unconfirmed markers, decision refs, mapping tables, inline mermaid and numeric NFRs. /harness-init scaffolds all of it into any repo, including a Company Context instance stub, check-conventions.py (the mechanical check that the conventions actually hold) and cookbook.md (the command sequences for real work). Bundled MCP server exposing Confluence, Jira, GitHub, GitLab, Microsoft Teams and Claude Code trigger tools; /pr works on both GitHub and GitLab. Pair with vnd-ai-sdlc-stockbook for Flutter specifics.
